Portronics Vayu 10 Tyre Inflator – Portable & Rechargeable Air Pump

The Portronics Vayu 10 Tyre Inflator is a compact, powerful, and reliable solution designed to keep your tyres perfectly inflated anytime, anywhere. Built for convenience and performance, this portable & rechargeable tyre inflator is ideal for cars, bikes, scooters, bicycles, and even sports balls. With its intelligent features like Type-C fast charging, LED digital display, and auto shut-off technology, Vayu 10 ensures safe, precise, and effortless inflation.

Whether you’re heading out on a long road trip or need quick air pressure correction at home, the offers professional-grade performance in a handheld design. Its cordless operation eliminates the need for bulky compressors or external power sources, making it one of the most dependable portable air compressors available today.

Key Features of Portronics Vayu 10 Tyre Inflator

  • Portable & Rechargeable Design: Lightweight and compact body makes it easy to carry in your car boot or backpack.
  • Type-C Fast Charging: Equipped with modern Type-C charging for quicker recharge and universal compatibility.
  • LED Digital Display: Real-time pressure monitoring with accurate PSI, BAR, and KPA readings.
  • Auto Shut-Off Function: Automatically stops inflation once the preset pressure is reached, preventing over-inflation.
  • Multi-Use Compatibility: Suitable for car tyres, bike tyres, bicycles, footballs, basketballs, and other sports balls.
  • Built-in LED Light: Bright LED torch helps during nighttime emergencies or low-light conditions.
  • High-Pressure Output: Delivers fast and efficient inflation with minimal noise.

Smart Inflation for Cars, Bikes & Sports Equipment

The is engineered to meet everyday inflation needs with precision. Its advanced motor delivers consistent air pressure, making it a dependable car tyre inflator as well as a powerful bike tyre inflator. The intelligent pressure detection system allows you to preset the desired air pressure, ensuring optimal tyre health and improved fuel efficiency. Thanks to its multiple nozzle attachments, this can also be used for inflating footballs, basketballs, yoga balls, and other inflatables. The digital LED display enhances usability by providing clear pressure readings, even in outdoor or low-light conditions.

Rechargeable Convenience with Type-C Charging

Equipped with a high-capacity rechargeable battery, the offers cordless freedom and dependable backup during emergencies. The inclusion of Type-C fast charging ensures reduced downtime and hassle-free charging using power banks, car chargers, or wall adapters. This feature-rich is especially useful during highway breakdowns, late-night travel, or unexpected pressure loss, providing peace of mind wherever you go.

Auto Shut-Off for Safety & Accuracy

Safety is a priority with the Vayu 10. Its auto shut-off technology automatically stops inflation once the set pressure is achieved, eliminating the risk of tyre damage due to over-inflation. This makes it an excellent choice for users looking for a reliable digital tyre inflator with smart control. The built-in LED flashlight further enhances usability, making it easier to inflate tyres in dark garages or during roadside emergencies.

Why Choose?

The combines portability, power, and smart technology into a single compact device. It is perfect for daily commuters, long-distance travelers, cyclists, and sports enthusiasts who demand reliability and performance. With its durable build quality and intuitive operation, Vayu 10 stands out as a must-have portable air pump for modern lifestyles. If you are searching for a dependable portable & rechargeable tyre inflator with advanced features and universal compatibility, Vayu 10 is the ideal solution for keeping your journeys smooth and worry-free.
